prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1172; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was making a left turn across the opposing lanes when the other vehicle came into the intersection.
Q: Which direction were you traveling before the turn?
A: I was heading north on the main road and wanted to turn west onto the side street. The light had been green, or I thought it was.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. I looked, but I saw it only a second before we hit. I braked, but there wasn't time.
Q: How fast do you estimate you were going?
A: Maybe twenty or twenty-five miles per hour. I was slowing down for the turn.
Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?
A: My head hit the side window and the steering wheel. I felt dizzy and had a bad headache. The paramedics checked me and took me to the hospital.
Q: Have you been diagnosed with anything?
A: Yes, the doctor said I have a concussion. I've been told to rest, avoid screens for long periods, and not drive for now.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. The headaches come and go, and I get tired quickly. Bright lights bother me.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm sorry the accident happened, and I'm cooperating so this can be settled.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
